mentions.name: BingeWorthyShows
mentions.description: This site aggregates curated YouTube channels and presents them in an easy-to-watch format, offering an alternative to endlessly scrolling through Netflix shows.
mentions.problem: People can't find anything better to watch and end up binging Netflix shows they don't really want to watch.
mentions.audience: Viewers looking for something better to watch than defaulting to Netflix
mentions.source_excerpt: My new project is https://bingeworthyshows.tv where i take all the curated YouTube channels and make them easy to watch so you don't have to rot your brain on Netflix shows you don't really want to watch but end up watching because you can't find anything better to watch
